note: Year 10 Foundation Foundation Summer Block 2 Graphs and diagrams: one set of templates per small step of the scheme of learning.

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S1 Pictograms
templates.text: The pictogram shows the number of books borrowed each day. How many books were borrowed on Tuesday?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S1 Pictograms
templates.text: The bar chart shows the number of pupils choosing each sport. How many pupils chose tennis? How many pupils are there in total?
templates.answer: [[f3]] chose tennis; [[f1 + f2 + f3 + f4]] pupils in total

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S1 Pictograms
templates.text: The pictogram shows the number of books borrowed each day. How many more books were borrowed on Thursday than on Monday?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S1 Pictograms
templates.text: The pictogram shows the books borrowed each day. (a) How many books were borrowed in total? (b) What fraction of the books were borrowed on Wednesday? Give your answer in its simplest form. (3 marks)

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S2 Vertical line and bar charts
templates.text: The vertical line chart shows the number of pets owned by some pupils. How many pupils have 2 pets?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S2 Vertical line and bar charts
templates.text: The vertical line chart shows the number of pets owned by some pupils. How many pupils are there? How many have at least 3 pets?
templates.answer: [[f0 + f1 + f2 + f3 + f4]] pupils; [[f3 + f4]] have at least 3 pets

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S2 Vertical line and bar charts
templates.text: The vertical line chart shows the number of pets owned by some pupils. Work out the mean number of pets to 1 decimal place.

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S2 Vertical line and bar charts
templates.text: The vertical line chart shows the number of pets owned by some pupils. (a) Write down the mode. (b) Write down the range. (c) What percentage of pupils have no pets? Give your answer to 1 decimal place. (4 marks)

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S3 Dual and composite bar charts
templates.text: The dual bar chart shows the number of boys and girls who bought a school lunch. How many girls bought a lunch on Tuesday?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S3 Dual and composite bar charts
templates.text: The dual bar chart shows the number of boys and girls who bought a school lunch. On Wednesday, how many more boys than girls bought a lunch?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S3 Dual and composite bar charts
templates.text: The dual bar chart shows the number of boys and girls who bought a school lunch. How many pupils bought a lunch on Monday? Which day had the most girls?
templates.answer: [[b1 + g1]] pupils; [[g1 == max(g1, g2, g3)|if:Monday/]][[g2 == max(g1, g2, g3)|if:Tuesday/]][[g3 == max(g1, g2, g3)|if:Wednesday/]]

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S3 Dual and composite bar charts
templates.text: The dual bar chart shows the number of boys and girls who bought a school lunch. (a) How many boys bought a lunch altogether? (b) How many more girls than boys bought a lunch altogether? (3 marks)

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S4 Interpret pie charts
templates.text: The pie chart shows the favourite sports of [[n]] pupils. How many pupils chose football?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S4 Interpret pie charts
templates.text: The pie chart shows the favourite sports of [[n]] pupils. What fraction chose tennis? Give your answer in its simplest form.

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S4 Interpret pie charts
templates.text: The pie chart shows the favourite sports of [[n]] pupils. How many more pupils chose rugby than hockey? (Hint: the angle for 1 pupil is [[360 / n]]°.)

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S4 Interpret pie charts
templates.text: The pie chart shows the favourite sports of [[n]] pupils. (a) What percentage chose hockey? (b) The same survey is repeated with [[m]] pupils and the same proportions. How many choose hockey? (4 marks)

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S5 Draw pie charts
templates.text: [[n]] pupils chose their favourite sport. Work out the angle for 1 pupil on a pie chart, and the angle for [[f]] pupils.
templates.answer: [[360 / n]]° for 1 pupil; [[f * 360 / n]]° for [[f]] pupils

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S5 Draw pie charts
templates.text: The table shows the favourite sports of [[f1 + f2 + f3 + f4]] pupils. Work out the angle for each sport on a pie chart.
templates.answer: Football [[f1 * 360 / n]]°, rugby [[f2 * 360 / n]]°, tennis [[f3 * 360 / n]]°, hockey [[f4 * 360 / n]]°

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S5 Draw pie charts
templates.text: A pie chart is to be drawn for [[n]] pupils. Ben says the angle for [[f]] pupils is [[f * 10]]°. Is he right? Work out the correct angle.
templates.answer: No: 360 ÷ [[n]] = [[360 / n]]° per pupil, so [[f]] pupils is [[f * 360 / n]]°

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S5 Draw pie charts
templates.text: The table shows how [[n]] pupils travel to school. Work out the angles for a pie chart and check they add up to 360°. (4 marks)

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S6 Frequency polygons
templates.text: The table shows the times (t minutes) that [[f1 + f2 + f3 + f4]] people waited: 0 ≤ t < 10: [[f1]], 10 ≤ t < 20: [[f2]], 20 ≤ t < 30: [[f3]], 30 ≤ t < 40: [[f4]]. A frequency polygon is drawn. At what $x$ value is the first point plotted?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S6 Frequency polygons
templates.text: A frequency polygon is drawn for waiting times in the classes 0 ≤ t < 10, 10 ≤ t < 20, 20 ≤ t < 30 and 30 ≤ t < 40 with frequencies [[f1]], [[f2]], [[f3]] and [[f4]]. Write down the coordinates of the four points.

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S6 Frequency polygons
templates.text: The frequency polygon shows waiting times. How many people waited between 20 and 30 minutes? How many people are there in total?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S6 Frequency polygons
templates.text: The frequency polygon shows waiting times. (a) Which is the modal class? (b) Work out an estimate of the mean waiting time. (3 marks)

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S7 Time series graphs
templates.text: The time series graph shows the average temperature each month. What was the temperature in month [[k]]?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S7 Time series graphs

templates.text: The time series graph shows the average temperature each month. What was the highest temperature, and in which month did it happen?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S7 Time series graphs
where: max(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6) > min(p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6)
templates.text: The time series graph shows the average temperature each month. What was the range of the temperatures?

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S7 Time series graphs
templates.text: The time series graph shows the average temperature each month. (a) Between which two months was the biggest rise? (b) What was the rise? (3 marks)

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S8 Stem-and-leaf diagrams
templates.text: The stem-and-leaf diagram shows 12 values (key: 1 | 2 means 12). Write down the smallest and the largest value.
templates.answer: Smallest [[10 + x1]]; largest [[40 + x4 + g4 + h4]]

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S8 Stem-and-leaf diagrams
templates.text: The stem-and-leaf diagram shows 12 values (key: 1 | 2 means 12). Work out the range.

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S8 Stem-and-leaf diagrams
templates.text: The stem-and-leaf diagram shows 12 values (key: 1 | 2 means 12). Work out the median.

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Summer B2 Graphs and diagrams · S8 Stem-and-leaf diagrams
templates.text: The stem-and-leaf diagram shows 12 values (key: 1 | 2 means 12). (a) How many values are greater than 30? (b) Work out the mean to 1 decimal place. (3 marks)
